23–25 ✓Center Ride OutRobert’s rideLos Angeles, CA · charity ride · LGBTQ+ · 3 days · 200+ miles over 3 days: Los Angeles to Ojai, camp, then… · raise $2,500 · Los Angeles guide →Details
Dates
Fri, Apr 23 – Sun, Apr 25, 2027
Where
Los Angeles, CA
Distances
200+ miles over 3 days: Los Angeles to Ojai, camp, then back along the coast (Day 3 is 80+ miles). 1-day riders ride Day 2 only.
Format
LGBTQ/HIV multi-day (3-day, camping)
Cause
LGBTQ+ — Los Angeles LGBT Center
Min. fundraising
$2,500 by April 2, 2027 for 3-day riders; $250 for 1-day riders. Registration $95 (3-day), $195 (1-day).
Organizer
Los Angeles LGBT Center
Registration
Open for 2027 (give.lalgbtcenter.org/event/center-ride-out-2027/e775406); first-come registration, not a lottery (2026 was capped at 525 participants)

DateThe Center and SFAF list April 23-25, 2027. Check-in is Thursday, April 22; the Finish Line Festival is Sunday, April 25, 12-8 pm, place to be announced. The 2026 ride was April 24-26.

NotesThe Los Angeles LGBT Center’s own ride. The first one, in April 2026, raised about $830,000 with about 300 riders. In 2027 it goes from LA to Ojai, camps there, and comes back along the coast to an oceanside finish.

Event siteSources: centerrideout.lalgbtcenter.org centerrideout.lalgbtcenter.org

21–23 ✓Cycle to ZeroRobert’s rideSan Francisco → San Francisco / Sausalito · charity ride · HIV/AIDS · 3 days · Day 1 SF to Guerneville ~85 mi; Day 2… · raise $2,500 · San Francisco guide →Details
Dates
Fri, May 21 – Sun, May 23, 2027
Where
San Francisco, CA
Route
San Francisco (2026 start: Fort Baker, Sausalito) → San Francisco / Sausalito (2026 finish: Martin Luther King Park, Sausalito)
Distances
Day 1 SF to Guerneville ~85 mi; Day 2 choose-your-own-adventure ~40 mi or ~100-mi century (2026 offered 38/65/104); Day 3 Guerneville to SF ~85 mi. Camping at Camp Russian River and Johnson’s Beach, Guerneville.
Format
HIV/AIDS multi-day (3-day, camping)
Cause
HIV/AIDS — San Francisco AIDS Foundation (HIV care/prevention, sexual health, substance-use and overdose-prevention programs)
Min. fundraising
3-Day Cyclists $500 by March 1, 2027 to hold a spot and $2,500 total by early May (the organizer gives both May 1 and May 4, 2027); Crew $250. Registration: 3-Day $95, 1-Day $225 (no minimum), Crew $95, DIY Squad $45
Organizer
San Francisco AIDS Foundation
Registration
Open for 2027 (donate.sfaf.org/event/cycle-to-zero-2027/e804781); limited capacity with waitlist, not a lottery; registrations non-refundable

DateOfficial 2027 site and FAQ state May 21-23, 2027 (1-Day option Saturday May 22, 2027). 2026 edition was May 29-31, 2026.

NotesSuccessor event to AIDS/LifeCycle on the SF side; 2026 inaugural edition had 700+ cyclists/crew and raised $1.6M+. Includes a DIY Squad remote-participation tier (not counted as an in-person ride option).

Event siteSources: 2027.cycletozero.org 2027.cycletozero.org
